description: Complete relational database theory, ER modeling, SQL, normalization (1NF-BCNF), ACID transactions, concurrency, and indexing.

topics.title: Database Systems vs File Systems, 3-Schema Architecture
topics.description: Advantages of DBMS over traditional file processing, physical/logical data independence, and ANSI/SPARC 3-schema architecture.
subtopics: Redundancy and inconsistency in file systems
Internal, Conceptual, and External schema levels

topics.title: Data Models (Relational, Hierarchical, Network, NoSQL)
topics.description: Evolution of data models: hierarchical tree, network graph, relational tables, and NoSQL categories.

topics.title: Entities, Attributes, Relationships and Cardinality
topics.description: Entity-Relationship diagrams, strong/weak entities, key attributes, composite/multivalued attributes, and cardinality ratios.
subtopics: ER diagram to relational table mapping

topics.title: Candidate, Primary, Super, Alternate and Foreign Keys
topics.description: Relational keys taxonomy: super keys, minimal candidate keys, primary keys, alternate keys, and foreign key references.

topics.title: Entity Integrity, Referential Integrity and Domain Constraints
topics.description: Integrity constraints: Entity integrity (no null PKs), Referential integrity (valid FK references or null), domain constraints, and check constraints.
subtopics: ON DELETE CASCADE / SET NULL / RESTRICT

topics.title: Select, Project, Union, Set Difference, Joins
topics.description: Procedural query language: Selection (sigma), Projection (pi), Cartesian product, Set operations, and Joins.

topics.title: CREATE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE and Constraints
topics.description: Data Definition Language (DDL): creating tables, altering column definitions, dropping/truncating tables, and enforcing constraints.
subtopics: PRIMARY KEY and FOREIGN KEY DDL

topics.title: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and Basic SELECT Queries
topics.description: Data Manipulation Language (DML): row insertion, conditional updates, deletions, and basic SELECT projections.

topics.title: GROUP BY, HAVING, COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX
topics.description: Aggregate functions, grouping rows with GROUP BY, and filtering grouped results using HAVING.
subtopics: Aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX)
GROUP BY single and multiple columns

topics.title: INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN and Self Joins
topics.description: Combining tables in SQL: inner joins, left/right outer joins, full outer joins, cross joins, and self joins.
subtopics: Self join on single table hierarchy

topics.title: Correlated Subqueries, Nested Queries and Views
topics.description: Subqueries in WHERE/FROM, correlated subqueries with EXISTS/IN, and virtual views.

topics.title: Functional Dependencies, 1NF, 2NF and 3NF
topics.description: Anomalies (insert/update/delete), Armstrong's axioms, 1NF (atomic attributes), 2NF (no partial dependency), 3NF (no transitive dependency).
subtopics: Second Normal Form (2NF) and Third Normal Form (3NF)

topics.title: Boyce-Codd Normal Form, Multivalued Dependencies and 4NF
topics.description: Strict BCNF (every determinant is a candidate key), 3NF vs BCNF comparison, multivalued dependencies, and 4NF.
subtopics: BCNF condition: X -> Y implies X is super key

topics.title: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation and Durability
topics.description: Transaction states (active, committed, aborted), ACID properties, and write-ahead logging (WAL).

topics.title: Locking Protocols, 2PL, Deadlocks and Timestamp Ordering
topics.description: Serializability (conflict vs view), Two-Phase Locking (2PL), rigorous 2PL, deadlock detection/prevention, and isolation levels.

topics.title: Primary, Secondary, Clustered Indexing and B/B+ Trees
topics.description: Disk storage mechanics, clustered vs non-clustered indexes, dense vs sparse indexes, and B/B+ Tree node structures.
subtopics: B+ Tree structure (data leaves with linked list pointers)
